# Editing Agent Provisioning Keys

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/editing-agent-provisioning-keys
**Captured:** 2026-10-18 via help_capture.py (article payload, canonical text)
**Revision:** node 1531960, revision 3243084

---

Agent provisioning keys are created during agent group configuration. You can edit or delete provisioning keys as needed outside agent group configuration.
To edit an agent provisioning key:
- From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Agent Groups and select an agent group.
- On the Provisioning Keys tab, click the Edit icon for the provisioning key you want to edit.
- See image.
- The Edit Provisioning Key drawer opens.
- In the Edit Provisioning Key drawer:
  - Name: Edit the provisioning key name.
  - Maximum Reuse of Key: The number of times the key can be reused. Enter a number from 1 to 1000.
  - Signing Certificate: Select a signing certificate from the drop-down menu.
  - See image.
  - Click Save.
Your updated provisioning key appears in the list of agent provisioning keys.
